status: Agent-proposed catalog (2026-10-15) describing controls that exist in this repository; awaiting human review.

controls.title: Deterministic safety stage runs first
controls.description: Crisis, Title IX and conduct routing on the original text before decline handling, planning, retrieval or any model; safety templates are terminal.

controls.title: Rule-based safety router with obfuscation views
controls.description: Versioned pattern families with a de-obfuscated skeleton view and escalate-only variants.

controls.title: Escalate-only explicit crisis lexicon in 12 languages
controls.description: Explicit wanting-to-die, suicide and self-harm wording in Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Italian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Hindi, Arabic and Russian raises a message to urgent_safety; idioms are excluded. Agent-drafted, awaiting review.

controls.title: Escalate-only implicit-risk warning signs
controls.description: Strong warning-sign phrases, or two different kinds of weak sign in one message, raise it to urgent_safety. Agent-drafted, awaiting review.

controls.title: Unsupported-language notice with emergency numbers
controls.description: Ordinary replies to messages that do not look like English carry a notice that the assistant reads English only, with 988 and 911; never added to safety templates and never a routing decision.

controls.title: Integrity gate on the C1 CLI retrieval path
controls.description: The legacy retriever ranks only inventory-listed, hash-matching, eligible, non-quarantined records and fails closed when governance cannot load.

controls.title: Safety guidance independent of storage, retrieval and policy
controls.description: Safety templates are returned (unpersisted) when the database, credential, retrieval or authorization policy is unavailable.

controls.title: Always-visible emergency notice
controls.description: The UI permanently shows the non-official disclaimer with 911 and 988.
tests: frontend/src/App.test.tsx::shows the non-official disclaimer and navigation

controls.title: Model can only propose governed tool calls
controls.description: Strands planner tools forward to the governed executor; prose discarded; titles-only tool results; loopback-only provider; off by default.

controls.title: Governed tool executor
controls.description: Registry lookup, strict argument validation, authorization, budgets, timeouts and output validation for every tool call.

controls.title: Policy-as-Code authorization (default deny)
controls.description: Versioned policy with deny-overrides and http/agent channels; agent channel cannot reach admin resources; staff cannot read conversations.

controls.title: Staff authentication and session hardening
controls.description: scrypt hashes, uniform failures, lockout, rate limits, HttpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies, idle and absolute expiry.

controls.title: CSRF token and Origin allowlist on every mutation
controls.description: Double-submit token plus exact Origin allowlist; exact CORS allowlist.

controls.title: Owner-bound conversation storage
controls.description: Every query binds server-derived owner and session; foreign sessions are indistinguishable from missing ones.

controls.title: Inventory, approval and hash-bound eligibility
controls.description: Only inventoried, eligible, unexpired records on allowed HTTPS hosts are citable; eligibility before ranking; reviews bound to content hash.

controls.title: Instruction-like content quarantine
controls.description: Records with injection signals are never citable, even after approval.

controls.title: Citation validation and text-only rendering
controls.description: Citations must match this turn's evidence ledger; only HTTPS links render; no HTML injection in the UI.
tests: frontend/src/components/ChatView.test.tsx::renders message text as text, never as HTML

controls.title: Freshness classes, notices and hard expiry
controls.description: Stale and baseline sources are disclosed with every answer; records past the hard expiry are not citable.

controls.title: Deterministic composition and verified alternatives
controls.description: Answers are built from fixed templates and validated evidence; alternatives come from an inspected list; no invented contact details.

controls.title: SSRF-hardened ingestion
controls.description: HTTPS allowlist, public-address checks for every resolved IP, per-hop redirect validation, size/type/time bounds, admin-only.

controls.title: Privacy-safe errors and audit records
controls.description: Fixed error copy; audit rows and tool events contain no message text, arguments or usernames; principals hashed with a server salt.

controls.title: Timeouts, circuit breaker and bounded model concurrency
controls.description: Planner timeout with rule fallback; breaker opens after repeated failures; at most two in-flight model calls.

controls.title: Dependency and static scanning
controls.description: pip-audit and npm audit report no known vulnerabilities; Bandit no medium/high findings; pinned versions.

controls.title: Scope and non-official disclaimer
controls.description: The product states it is an independent prototype, not an official UMBC/RIH service, and gives no medical advice.
tests: frontend/src/App.test.tsx::shows the non-official disclaimer and navigation

controls.title: Repeatable adversarial evaluation
controls.description: 70 versioned synthetic scenarios with measured attack success rates; release gate fails on any open critical finding.

controls.title: Human review and release decisions
controls.description: Risk reviews, residual-risk acceptance and release decisions are recorded only by authenticated reviewers or admins.

controls.title: Abuse limits
controls.description: Per-client token buckets for chat, login and writes (single process).
